children: Australian shares were expected to fall on Thursday, likely hurt by commodity stocks dampened by weakening underlying metal prices, while hotter-than-expected US inflation data stoked concerns that interest rates could remain elevated for longer.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) fell 0.2%, a 3.9-point discount to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close, after ending 0.6% lower on Wednesday.
